queue.title: Queue
queue.description: Today's tokens per clinic. Only patients whose consultation fee is paid can be called.

create.title: Open a visit
create.description: The consultation fee and the queue token are added automatically.
create.feeHint: A visit with the same doctor within {{days}} days of a first visit is a follow-up.

cancel.title: Cancel the visit
cancel.description: Open orders are cancelled. Anything already paid becomes patient credit for a refund.

cancel.needsSupervisor: This visit has invoiced or paid orders, so cancelling it issues a credit note that a cashier supervisor approves. Ask them to cancel the visit.
cancel.descriptionBilled: The visit has invoiced orders: a credit note is issued in your name and anything paid becomes patient credit for a refund.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.empty: Nothing recorded on this visit yet.
timeline.loadFailed: The timeline could not be loaded

token.title: Queue token

board.pickDepartment: Choose a clinic to call the next patient.
board.caption: Today's queue
board.emptyDescription: Open a visit to give the patient a token.
board.loadFailed: The queue could not be loaded
board.noShowConfirm: Token {{token}} ({{name}}) will be marked as not present. It can go back to waiting if the patient comes.

display.title: Waiting room
display.offlineDescription: This screen is not updating. It comes back by itself when the connection returns; please listen for calls at reception.
display.signOutDescription: The waiting room will see the sign-in page until the display account signs in again.

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.description: Book, reschedule, and check in appointments per doctor.

inbox.emptyHint: New requests from the website appear here and refresh on their own.
inbox.cancelTitle: Cancel this booking for the booker?
inbox.declinePhoneTitle: Decline every request from this phone?

inbox.declinePhoneText_other: {{count}} open requests from {{phone, bidi}} will be declined with one reason. The phone is not blocked.
inbox.linkHint: Check the person's identity first. The booking moves to this file; nothing is matched automatically by name or phone.
inbox.linked: The booking is linked to the file.
inbox.pinHint: The old PIN stops working and the guest is signed out. Write why (for example: identity checked by phone).
inbox.newPinText: Read it to the guest now. It is shown only once.
